title: Records in a mapped view
description:
Read fixed-size records from a "view" of a file with bounds checks.

```
view of 100 bytes, records of 24 bytes: 4 whole records (4 bytes left over)
record 2: id 3, score 77, name "Cy"
record 9: out of range
```
hints: Record `i` starts at `i * sizeof(Record)`; it fits when `start + sizeof(Record) <= view.size()` (lesson 3.04).
A real `MapViewOfFile` view looks the same to this code: a pointer and a size.
requirements: The view is a `std::span<const std::uint8_t>`; records are read with `std::memcpy` into a struct.
`count()` and `get(i)` never read past the end of the view.
Refuse a view whose header magic is wrong.
stretch: Write records back into a writable view, then "flush" by copying the vector to a file.
